caption: LUM-1490 footerData (the host->JS query channel) through the real bridge. The harness starts a real git repository in the child's cwd (`git_init`, branch `lum1490-main`) and an extension installs a custom footer that prints what `footerData` answered. Panel 1: `getGitBranch()`/`getAvailableProviderCount()` are queried from inside `render()` and return the driver's snapshot (`branch=lum1490-main`), not the hardcoded `undefined` this stub used to return. Panel 2: `! git checkout -b lum1490-side` moves HEAD outside the app and the footer follows without a restart, because the driver re-reads HEAD every tick and the shim fires the `onBranchChange` subscribers it registered the way upstream's own example does (`changes=1`). Panel 3: `/default-footer` restores the built-in footer, which shows `(lum1490-side)` - the same tracker feeds it, so the built-in footer follows an external checkout too (before LUM-1490 it was resolved once at startup). Panel 4: `git checkout --detach HEAD` then the custom footer again reads `branch=null`, upstream's answer for a detached HEAD / a session outside a repo. Captured with scripts/pty_capture_win.py on Windows 10 (ConPTY), 100x26, real pi.exe, real keystrokes, real repaints.

panels.label: 1. the custom footer reads footerData: branch=lum1490-main, providers=N

expect.why: `getGitBranch()` answered the branch of the repository the session runs in: the driver pushed it (`sync_footer_data`) and the shim queried it back from inside `render()`
the initial snapshot is not a branch *transition*: a subscriber must not be told about a value it never saw change (upstream's `onBranchChange` fires on a HEAD move)
`getAvailableProviderCount()` answers the same count the built-in footer's `(provider) ` prefix is built from; 0 would mean the snapshot was never seeded

reject.why: the pre-LUM-1490 shim hardcoded `getGitBranch: () => undefined`; that string is the regression marker for the stub coming back

panels.label: 2. `! git checkout -b lum1490-side`: the footer follows HEAD without a restart

expect.why: the driver re-reads `.git/HEAD` every tick (upstream watches the file), so a checkout performed by a child process reaches both the App and the `footerData` snapshot
`onBranchChange` fired exactly once for one move - the channel is live, and it is not double-firing per frame

reject.why: a stale branch here would mean the snapshot is resolved once at startup (the pre-LUM-1490 driver behaviour)

panels.label: 3. `/default-footer`: the built-in footer shows (lum1490-side) as well

expect.why: the handler ran; the footer row below is the evidence, this line only proves dispatch
the built-in footer's location row joins its own branch from the *same* tracker, so it follows an external checkout too (LUM-1466 resolved it once at startup)
upstream's `getGitBranch()` is `string | null` and resolves a detached HEAD to `null` (`footer-data-provider.ts:126-131`); the shim folds the host's absent value into that same `null`
the footer was uninstalled while the detach happened and the re-install only queries, so no transition is invented: `1` is still the single move from panel 2

reject.why: a detached HEAD is `null` upstream, not `undefined`: if the shim stopped folding the host's absent value into `null`, the frame would say so
